shots.title: Seed
shots.prompt: A fictional young botanist in a moss-green coat plants a silver seed in a moonlit glasshouse; a red notebook rests beside the clay pot.

shots.title: Bloom
shots.prompt: In the same glasshouse, the same botanist opens the red notebook as a luminous blue vine grows from the same clay pot.

shots.title: Release
shots.prompt: The same botanist raises the same clay pot while the blue vine releases exactly three glowing moths and the red notebook remains open.
